[ASSISTANT_SAID] Learning a new language can delay the onset of age-related cognitive decline and protect against conditions like Alzheimer's and dementia.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Learning a language doesn't have to be daunting; there are many fun and interactive ways to do it.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Examples of fun ways to learn a language include watching movies in the target language, listening to music, or playing language-learning games.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Practicing with a friend or family member who speaks the language or enrolling in a language class at school or in the community are also suggested methods.
